future_review_contract.authorization: No assessment destination is configured and no images may be transferred by this preparation tool. Actual derived bytes and destination need a separate frozen authorized assessment task.
future_review_contract.boundaries: Label uncertainty and camera partitions explicitly; frame coverage does not establish review completeness or rally/contact timing.
future_review_contract.independence: Two future passes receive only source images, frame/PTS/view identities and a fixed rubric; neither sees other-pass or historical semantic labels/predictions.
future_review_contract.purpose: Prospective coarse live/replay/non_play/unknown scene context only; not accepted truth.
future_review_contract.uncertainty: Insufficient thumbnail detail, missing coverage or unresolved boundaries stay unknown and require separately authorized native-source adjudication.

input_policy: Only the frozen projected inventory and context diagnostics plus the two original source media are consumed.
No original visibility/coordinate/score/component/pose/contact/shot labels, predictions, checkpoints or consumed generated-test rows are read.
Source bytes, native PTS/time bases, enumeration, orientation, camera context partitions and every view/case occurrence remain bound.
limitations: Every native frame is represented at reduced resolution, without certifying visible scene detail or source review.
All original contexts/results/deadlines remain preserved; no scientific run or accuracy evaluation occurs.
Complete independent rally references remain0/2 and full automatic match accuracy is unproven.
name: frozen-familiar-source-scene-preparation-v1
partition_policy: Every view is separate; chronological sheets retain every native frame occurrence in up to16 cells.
Cells name their original context partition and its first native frame; a sheet can contain a marked partition boundary.
Context partition boundaries are preserved source metadata, not independently reviewed visual edits or scene labels.
No context, scene exclusion, live label or truth is inferred across a partition, a timestamp discontinuity or missing input.

render.fit: contain original aspect with black padding

verification: Freeze tested producer/helper/protocol/input hashes before original decode; exclusive attempts and actual shared Store admission.
Generated exact mapping/orientation/cuts/coverage/packing/admission/source-mutation regressions, then full required software checks.
Separate post-exit audit verifies original process absence/Store completion, image hashes and actual source clocks by independent sequential decode.
Only aggregate report/provenance published; code/protocol through normal PR/controller/main/public delivery.
